title: Learn a small flag measurement without enumerating a huge error alphabet
statement: Physical Bell-label/flag measurements estimate subnormalized positive sigma_x; only observed labels need storage. Merge all unobserved empirical effects into ONE actual unseen dummy, retaining the full empirical optimum. A uniform operator event gives regret2r delta+eta for certified optimization, plus kappa for physical receiver synthesis. A compact POVM uses at most r² whole-system Pauli corrections. For arbitrary coherent channels this optimizes the declared flag/Pauli class; full-CPTP optimality requires the actual Pauli-plus-flag source.
